open_points.subject: Credential search
open_points.text: “The one search it makes in any answer body, a file's included, is for a credential echoed verbatim” does not say which configured credentials are searched; M28 carries service-credential references, owner tokens and agent tokens.
open_points.question: Which credential values does the kernel read and compare against each microservice answer body?
options: Only the credential used for that service request
All service credentials plus owner and agent tokens
open_points.default_guess: Search for the resolved credential used for that request only.

open_points.subject: SpooledFile creation for a withheld file answer
open_points.text: K-10 says a credential-bearing file answer is withheld and never used as an output, while M22 defines a SpooledFile as a file observed while receiving bytes and says its record remains after the bytes are removed.
open_points.question: When a returned file contains an echoed credential, is a SpooledFile record minted, and are any bytes or non-payload facts such as digest and size retained?
options: Mint no SpooledFile and retain no facts or bytes
Retain a SpooledFile record but immediately remove its bytes
Retain a separate rejected-response record without making it an output
open_points.default_guess: Mint no SpooledFile and retain no response bytes or content-derived metadata.

open_points.subject: Inspection of credential-bearing file answers
open_points.text: K-10 says the credential-bearing answer body “is withheld from everyone, the owner included,” but M22 says a SpooledFile is read “by the owner inspecting its bytes — part of the State 0 inspect action, owner only whatever the class, while its run holds its spool.”
open_points.question: Does the owner-inspection rule exclude a returned file whose body contains an echoed credential, or does such a file never become an inspectable SpooledFile?
options: They become SpooledFiles but byte inspection is forbidden
The owner may inspect them despite the withholding statement
open_points.default_guess: Credential-bearing files never become SpooledFiles and therefore are never inspectable.
